content.short: ChainsightAnalytics is a DeFi tooling platform.
content.description: ChainsightAnalytics provides a broad suite of dashboards that illuminate diverse topics within decentralized finance. These dashboards help analysts uncover overlooked corners of the market and monitor key metrics with clarity. The collection features MEV-Boost performance, arbitrage bot tracking, DEX liquidity versus volume, and aggregator analysis, delivering actionable insights to understand market dynamics and track activity across multiple chains, including Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana, and BNB Chain.
